The '''Blackhawk Destroyer''' was a sleek, personal [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]].

==Characteristics==
The craft could fit at least three people and was meant only for short excursions into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], having no [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

==History==
[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Coby]] of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] bought a Blackhawk Destroyer on [[Chuzalla]] in an attempt at retrieving his pet [[Ingey]] from the [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]]. After running out of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]], he used the ship to latch onto the Starhunters' [[Starhunter menagerie ark|menagerie ark]] and travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Coby crashed the vessel on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dandelo]].
